subject: toy-like Velociraptor with a toothache in a desert

visual_logic.composition: A sleek Velociraptor standing in a moonlit Gobi-style desert. He has a mix of scales and colorful feathers on his arms and tail. His famous 'sickle claw' on his foot is visible in the sand.
visual_logic.action: He is holding his jaw with one clawed hand, looking very annoyed. His mouth is slightly open, showing that one of his sharp, hooked teeth is missing.
visual_logic.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; maintain the 'toy' feel with rounded edges. Use cool blue moonlight to contrast with the warm orange of the Pachycephalosaur levels.
